description: Translates text into International Morse code and returns the sound as a WAV audio file (8 kHz mono), with the code as text and a link to the translator on morsecodetranslator.com. Choose the speed in words per minute (5-40, default 20) and the tone in hertz (300-1000, default 600). The sound can be at most 60 seconds long: use a higher speed or a shorter text for more.

frequency.description: The tone in hertz, 300 to 1000. Default: 600.

text.description: The text to play as Morse code, at most 200 characters.

wpm.description: The speed in words per minute, 5 to 40. Default: 20.

name: morse_audio
title: Morse code audio
